card.name: Edition number in Columbia Encyclopedia citation
card.fires_on: The digit 6 in the encyclopedia citation "The Columbia Electronic Encyclopedia, 6th ed. Copyright". Weaker hits come on 'ed' in the same citation and on a few spots in instructions like "Simply begin typing".

card.writes: It suppresses 'simply', 'just' and 'merely', so it mostly stops those words from coming next.
card.plain: It lights up on the edition number in a Columbia Encyclopedia citation line, and a little on 'simply do this' instructions.
